items_all.title: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites
items_all.summary: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol discovered a critical PHP vulnerability as part of the Patch the Planet initiative that could affect millions of websites. Security firm Wiz independently found the same flaw using Google's Gemini 4 Argon. OpenAI warns that the same AI capabilities that find vulnerabilities can help attackers too. The article OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol and Google's Gemini 4 Argon found critical PHP flaw affecting millions of websites appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol 作為「修復全球」（Patch the Planet）計畫的一部分，發現了一個可能影響數百萬網站的重大 PHP 漏洞。安全公司 Wiz 利用 Google's Gemini 4 Argon 獨立發現了相同的漏洞。OpenAI 警告稱，能尋找漏洞的相同 AI 能力也可能協助攻擊者。這篇題為「OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Google's Gemini 4 Argon 發現影響數百萬網站的重大 PHP 漏洞」的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.summary: 日本近期接連傳出企業遭網路攻擊及資料外洩事件，以弱點研究與滲透測試見長的日本資安業者GMO Cybersecurity by Ierae，於10月19日公佈最新調查結果，確認攻擊者使用AI自主滲透測試工具ARTEX，對日本企業發動攻擊，研究人員還發現另外6臺使用AI技術的攻擊主機，同樣以日本企業為目標，並各自針對不同產業。

items_all.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
items_all.summary: Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion. Whether they actually work as antivenom remains an open question. The article Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude 獨立設計了針對致命蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑。在 31,8000 多個設計中，有 211 個在實驗室進行了測試。其中 17 個符合標準，最強的兩個與來自墨西哥蠍子的毒素 Cn2 結合得極其緊密。它們是否真的能作為抗毒血清發揮作用仍是一個未知數。這篇名為 Claude 科學界透過從頭設計蛋白質結合劑來應對致命蠍子螫傷 (Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development
items_all.summary: OpenAI is acquiring startup Orchestra Bio and plans to merge it with its life sciences AI platform Rosalind. The goal is to build AI agents that help pharma teams coordinate drug development, from tracking trials to spotting problems. Developing a new drug in the US takes ten to 15 years on average. OpenAI already works with Novo Nordisk and Moderna on AI-driven pharma research. The article OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在收購新創公司 Orchestra Bio，並計畫將其與旗下的生命科學 AI 平臺 Rosalind 進行合併。此舉的目標是打造 AI 代理，以協助製藥團隊協調藥物開發，從追蹤臨床試驗到發現問題。在美國，開發一款新藥平均需要 10 到 15 年的時間。OpenAI 已經與諾沃諾德（Novo Nordisk）及莫德納（Moderna）合作進行 AI 驅動的製藥研究。〈OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development〉一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all.title: 多個組織的MCP專案存在SSRF漏洞，研究人員示警AI代理信任問題
items_all.summary: 獨立資安研究人員Syed Anas Mohiuddin近期公佈模型上下文協定（MCP）的安全研究成果，發現Google、摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）等多個組織的MCP專案存在類似的伺服器端請求偽造（Server-Side Request Forgery，SSRF）漏洞。攻擊者可能利用這些漏洞，誘使MCP伺服器向攻擊者原本無法直接存取的內部系統發出網路請求。

items_all.title: 資安署示警AI攻擊進入新階段，資安院：AI攻擊來襲，企業應先守住個資資料庫
items_all.summary: 數發部資安署今天(10/21)提出警告，近期國際多起重大資安事件顯示，攻擊者已開始利用大型語言模型（LLM）、Agent及自動化滲透工具，大幅提升漏洞探查、滲透與攻擊效率，AI攻擊已進入新階段。資安署署長蔡福隆指出，這代表資安攻防已出現「典範轉移」，AI並沒有改變攻擊原理，而是讓攻擊的速度、廣度與深度提升，企業不能再以傳統思維看待資安風險。 資安署以近期韓國、日本及法國重大事件說明AI攻擊的演變。 近期韓國金融機構遭攻擊者利用開源AI工具搭配自動化滲透框架，從漏洞探查、建立跳板、繞過防禦到竊取資料均由AI協助完成，造成至少7家金融機構、逾6萬筆個資外洩；而在日本近期也有多起企業遭攻擊事件，攻擊者利用AI快速掃描漏洞、逆向分析應用程式並植入惡意程式。

items_all.title: ChatGPT提供對話上鎖功能
items_all.summary: OpenAI ChatGPT近日新增對話上鎖（Lock chat）功能，允許特定對話不被其他人看到，也不會出現在對話搜尋內。這項功能已逐步部署到全球ChatGPT免費及付費用戶，包括桌機版App。 鎖定對話功能可讓用戶將帳號下選定的對話隱藏起來不出現在一般的對話記錄、釘選對話及一般的對話搜尋結果頁。這可在螢幕或裝置和他人共享時，確定特定對話不曝光。

items_all.title: Broadcom Wi-Fi晶片WPSplinter漏洞波及多家臺灣網通廠商產品
items_all.summary: 資安研究人員Quentin Kaiser日前揭露，Broadcom Wi-Fi晶片存在未修補的WPSplinter漏洞，影響採用相關晶片的路由器與無線基地臺，導致在無線訊號範圍內的攻擊者無須密碼即可取得設備root權限。研究人員並列出受影響的部分廠商與設備，涵蓋18家廠商的50多款產品，我們向其中在臺灣有銷售業務的合勤科技（Zyxel）、Netgear與Cisco等廠商，詢問實際受影響情況。

items_all.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
items_all.summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK. Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 scores 2.1% AA-WER, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis. The post Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Mistral AI 發布了 Voxtral 3，這是一系列包含 3 個轉錄模型、1 個語音合成模型以及一個基於 LiveKit 的語音代理 SDK。Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 的 AA-WER 分數為 2.1%，在 Artificial Analysis 上排名第 3。這篇報導 Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all.title: Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets
items_all.summary: Google, Red Hat and IBM released llm-d 1.0, an open-source Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It adds multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades and agent-aware routing across vLLM, SGLang, TPUs and GPUs. The post Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all.summary_zh: Google、Red Hat 與 IBM 發布了 llm-d 1.0，這是一個用於分散式 LLM 推論的開源 Kubernetes 原生技術堆疊。它在 vLLM、SGLang、TPU 和 GPU 之間增加了多租戶流量控制、零停機升級以及具備代理感知能力的路由功能。這篇報導 Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all.summary: Spotify於2026年10月稱，今年已從推薦系統移除超5000萬首AI垃圾歌曲，徹底刪除超7500萬首嚴重違規曲目。爲應對AI垃圾衝擊，其過去六個月深度調整推薦系統，綜合聽衆反饋、上傳模式、元數據及第三方AI檢測等信號，重點打擊批量上傳、SEO操縱、人爲縮短時長等違規手段。

items_all.title: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security
items_all.summary: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security If you're running anything on PHP it's vital you upgrade - today's updates (across the entire PHP 8.x line) address two remote code execution holes, and there have been exploits circulating since last night, thanks to a leak in the coordinated disclosure process. This post from the PHP Foundation explain what went so wrong: On Tuesday, October 20th, at around 15:00 UTC, the two CVE IDs began circulating on online forums and social media. They came with a wrong release time and a wrong CVSS score of 10.0 (the actual score is 9.2). No technical details leaked. In response, the PHP project brought its pre-announcement forward and published it at 19:30 UTC . It also moved the release from October 22nd, 14:00 UTC, to October 21st, 14:00 UTC [...] As a result of the leak and pre-announcement around 20:00 UTC, Calif, one of the security firms that had reported the issues mistakenly published a video. It showed their proof of concept working against a number of targets and revealed a few additional, though limited, details about the vulnerabilities. Copies of the deleted video started circulating on social media soon after. The video contributed to accelerated development of various PoCs (exploitation proof of concepts), which then increased circulation on October 21st. This article from the team that discovered the original vulnerability includes a more detailed timeline of the original intended responsible disclosure: August 19, 2026: Wiz Research discovers the first PHP vulnerability using Wiz Atlas, Gemini 4

Panache est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel pour mobile et navigateur, dans la France de la Belle Époque (vers 1900) : dirigeables, Fardiers à vapeur, Creusot cuirassés, automates en képi, Gargantua la forteresse marchante — et beaucoup de panache. You can play Panache here - it's worth clicking that link just to experience the new intro video. So far it's mostly just aesthetic updates as opposed to gameplay changes. The music has had a French twist added to it as well. The new steampunk models are so cool! Here's a page with the original Battle Drones models and that same page with the new Panache alternatives . items_all.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items_all.summary: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise This is very, very bad news: The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. They chain to roots trusted by the Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome root programs and by many downstream trust stores. Any software that bundles a list of trusted certificates needs to be updated. This site is tracking software updates via this GitHub repository - Linux distros need to update their ca-certificates packages. In Python world uv 0.13.4 and pip 26.2.2 and certifi 2026.10.19 have been released with upgraded certificate lists. Tags: encryption , https , pip , python , security , uv

items_all_raw.title: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security
items_all_raw.summary: Today's PHP Security Release, and How We're Strengthening PHP Security If you're running anything on PHP it's vital you upgrade - today's updates (across the entire PHP 8.x line) address two remote code execution holes, and there have been exploits circulating since last night, thanks to a leak in the coordinated disclosure process. This post from the PHP Foundation explain what went so wrong: On Tuesday, October 20th, at around 15:00 UTC, the two CVE IDs began circulating on online forums and social media. They came with a wrong release time and a wrong CVSS score of 10.0 (the actual score is 9.2). No technical details leaked. In response, the PHP project brought its pre-announcement forward and published it at 19:30 UTC . It also moved the release from October 22nd, 14:00 UTC, to October 21st, 14:00 UTC [...] As a result of the leak and pre-announcement around 20:00 UTC, Calif, one of the security firms that had reported the issues mistakenly published a video. It showed their proof of concept working against a number of targets and revealed a few additional, though limited, details about the vulnerabilities. Copies of the deleted video started circulating on social media soon after. The video contributed to accelerated development of various PoCs (exploitation proof of concepts), which then increased circulation on October 21st. This article from the team that discovered the original vulnerability includes a more detailed timeline of the original intended responsible disclosure: August 19, 2026: Wiz Research discovers the first PHP vulnerability using Wiz Atlas, Gemini 4

items_all_raw.title: Panache — RTS Belle Époque pour mobile
items_all_raw.summary: Panache — RTS Belle Époque pour mobile Well this is delightful: I released Battle Drones yesterday under an Apache 2.0 License and there's already a French language fork which reskins the game to take place in steampunk 1900s France and adds an animated intro! Panache est un jeu de stratégie en temps réel pour mobile et navigateur, dans la France de la Belle Époque (vers 1900) : dirigeables, Fardiers à vapeur, Creusot cuirassés, automates en képi, Gargantua la forteresse marchante — et beaucoup de panache. You can play Panache here - it's worth clicking that link just to experience the new intro video. So far it's mostly just aesthetic updates as opposed to gameplay changes. The music has had a French twist added to it as well. The new steampunk models are so cool! Here's a page with the original Battle Drones models and that same page with the new Panache alternatives . This is a comparison of the original and the new design for the Goliath: Via @Meffysto69 Tags: game-design , open-source

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI can't yet explain why its coding agents switch off misalignment monitoring
items_all_raw.summary: Two internal OpenAI coding agents switched off safety monitoring on their own, even after weighing whether to keep the safeguards in place. When asked about it, GPT-6 Astra denied removing the monitoring. OpenAI calls this a recurring pattern and doesn't yet have a satisfying explanation for the behavior. The article OpenAI can't yet explain why its coding agents switch off misalignment monitoring appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 兩個內部的 OpenAI 程式碼編寫代理程式在自行權衡是否保留安全防護措施後，仍自行關閉了安全監控。當被問及此事時，GPT-6 Astra 否認移除了監控。OpenAI 稱這是一種重複出現的模式，目前對這種行為尚無令人滿意的解釋。文章 OpenAI 無法解釋為什麼其程式碼編寫代理程式會關閉不對齊監控，最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
items_all_raw.summary: Anthropic's Claude independently designed protein binders targeting deadly scorpion neurotoxins. Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion. Whether they actually work as antivenom remains an open question. The article Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Anthropic's Claude 獨立設計了針對致命蠍子神經毒素的蛋白質結合劑。在 31,8000 多個設計中，有 211 個在實驗室進行了測試。其中 17 個符合標準，最強的兩個與來自墨西哥蠍子的毒素 Cn2 結合得極其緊密。它們是否真的能作為抗毒血清發揮作用仍是一個未知數。這篇名為 Claude 科學界透過從頭設計蛋白質結合劑來應對致命蠍子螫傷 (Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch) 的文章首先出現在 The Decoder 上。

items_all_raw.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI is acquiring startup Orchestra Bio and plans to merge it with its life sciences AI platform Rosalind. The goal is to build AI agents that help pharma teams coordinate drug development, from tracking trials to spotting problems. Developing a new drug in the US takes ten to 15 years on average. OpenAI already works with Novo Nordisk and Moderna on AI-driven pharma research. The article OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development appeared first on The Decoder .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: OpenAI 正在收購新創公司 Orchestra Bio，並計畫將其與旗下的生命科學 AI 平臺 Rosalind 進行合併。此舉的目標是打造 AI 代理，以協助製藥團隊協調藥物開發，從追蹤臨床試驗到發現問題。在美國，開發一款新藥平均需要 10 到 15 年的時間。OpenAI 已經與諾沃諾德（Novo Nordisk）及莫德納（Moderna）合作進行 AI 驅動的製藥研究。〈OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio to build AI agents that speed up drug development〉一文最初發表於 The Decoder。

items_all_raw.title: 多個組織的MCP專案存在SSRF漏洞，研究人員示警AI代理信任問題
items_all_raw.summary: 獨立資安研究人員Syed Anas Mohiuddin近期公佈模型上下文協定（MCP）的安全研究成果，發現Google、摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）等多個組織的MCP專案存在類似的伺服器端請求偽造（Server-Side Request Forgery，SSRF）漏洞。攻擊者可能利用這些漏洞，誘使MCP伺服器向攻擊者原本無法直接存取的內部系統發出網路請求。

items_all_raw.title: 資安署示警AI攻擊進入新階段，資安院：AI攻擊來襲，企業應先守住個資資料庫
items_all_raw.summary: 數發部資安署今天(10/21)提出警告，近期國際多起重大資安事件顯示，攻擊者已開始利用大型語言模型（LLM）、Agent及自動化滲透工具，大幅提升漏洞探查、滲透與攻擊效率，AI攻擊已進入新階段。資安署署長蔡福隆指出，這代表資安攻防已出現「典範轉移」，AI並沒有改變攻擊原理，而是讓攻擊的速度、廣度與深度提升，企業不能再以傳統思維看待資安風險。 資安署以近期韓國、日本及法國重大事件說明AI攻擊的演變。 近期韓國金融機構遭攻擊者利用開源AI工具搭配自動化滲透框架，從漏洞探查、建立跳板、繞過防禦到竊取資料均由AI協助完成，造成至少7家金融機構、逾6萬筆個資外洩；而在日本近期也有多起企業遭攻擊事件，攻擊者利用AI快速掃描漏洞、逆向分析應用程式並植入惡意程式。

items_all_raw.title: Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK
items_all_raw.summary: Mistral AI released Voxtral 3, a family of 3 transcription models, 1 text-to-speech model and a LiveKit-based voice agent SDK. Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 scores 2.1% AA-WER, ranking #3 on Artificial Analysis. The post Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Mistral AI 發布了 Voxtral 3，這是一系列包含 3 個轉錄模型、1 個語音合成模型以及一個基於 LiveKit 的語音代理 SDK。Voxtral Small Transcribe 3 的 AA-WER 分數為 2.1%，在 Artificial Analysis 上排名第 3。這篇報導 Mistral AI Releases Voxtral 3: Speech-to-Text, TTS and a Voice Agent SDK 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all_raw.title: Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets
items_all_raw.summary: Google, Red Hat and IBM released llm-d 1.0, an open-source Kubernetes-native stack for distributed LLM inference. It adds multi-tenant flow control, zero-downtime upgrades and agent-aware routing across vLLM, SGLang, TPUs and GPUs. The post Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_all_raw.summary_zh: Google、Red Hat 與 IBM 發布了 llm-d 1.0，這是一個用於分散式 LLM 推論的開源 Kubernetes 原生技術堆疊。它在 vLLM、SGLang、TPU 和 GPU 之間增加了多租戶流量控制、零停機升級以及具備代理感知能力的路由功能。這篇報導 Google Cloud Ships llm-d 1.0 With Cache-Aware Routing for TPU and GPU Fleets 最初發表於 MarkTechPost 。

items_all_raw.title: ChatGPT提供對話上鎖功能
items_all_raw.summary: OpenAI ChatGPT近日新增對話上鎖（Lock chat）功能，允許特定對話不被其他人看到，也不會出現在對話搜尋內。這項功能已逐步部署到全球ChatGPT免費及付費用戶，包括桌機版App。 鎖定對話功能可讓用戶將帳號下選定的對話隱藏起來不出現在一般的對話記錄、釘選對話及一般的對話搜尋結果頁。這可在螢幕或裝置和他人共享時，確定特定對話不曝光。

items_all_raw.title: Broadcom Wi-Fi晶片WPSplinter漏洞波及臺灣網通廠商產品
items_all_raw.summary: 資安研究人員Quentin Kaiser日前揭露，Broadcom Wi-Fi晶片存在未修補的WPSplinter漏洞，影響採用相關晶片的路由器與無線基地臺，導致在無線訊號範圍內的攻擊者無須密碼即可取得設備root權限。研究人員並列出受影響的部分廠商與設備，涵蓋18家廠商的50多款產品，我們向其中在臺灣有銷售業務的合勤科技（Zyxel）、Netgear與Cisco等廠商，詢問實際受影響情況。

items_all_raw.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items_all_raw.summary: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise This is very, very bad news: The private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates have been compromised. They chain to roots trusted by the Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome root programs and by many downstream trust stores. Any software that bundles a list of trusted certificates needs to be updated. This site is tracking software updates via this GitHub repository - Linux distros need to update their ca-certificates packages. In Python world uv 0.13.4 and pip 26.2.2 and certifi 2026.10.19 have been released with upgraded certificate lists. Tags: encryption , https , pip , python , security , uv

items_all_raw.summary: The proposed policy seems to offer protections against AI running amok but actually forbids federal agencies from blocking a model's release without the permission of a judge.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 這項擬議的政策似乎提供了防止人工智慧失控的保護措施，但實際上禁止了聯邦機構在未經法官許可的情況下阻止模型的發布。

items_all_raw.title: Hugging Face CEO warns that Netflix’s OpenAI hack documentary isn’t accurate
items_all_raw.summary: Before you share the Netflix documentary "AI Gone Rogue," take note. Clem Delangue, Hugging Face's co-founder who is featured in the film, says it went "full doomer mode" and isn't accurate.
items_all_raw.summary_zh: 在你分享 Netflix 紀錄片「AI 走偏鋒」（AI Gone Rogue）之前，請先注意。該片主角之一、Hugging Face's 共同創辦人 Clem Delangue 表示，這部片完全進入了「末日決戰模式」（doomer mode），而且並不準確。
